name: Constellation labels
description: Constellation label positions in the J2000 celestial reference, with identifiers, multilingual names and display attributes from d3-celestial. GeoJSON and GeoPackage contain point geometries; the complementary CSV contains attributes without geometry.
citeAs: Part of Celestial Data (1.0.1), collection DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7561601. The DOI identifies the archived collection, not a separate DOI for this dataset.

recordSet.name: records
recordSet.description: One record per source feature or CSV row in its original order. No values are imputed. Publication dates describe the collection release, not observations; J2000 is a celestial reference epoch, not a file date. The row-position key is local to this snapshot.

field.name: record_index
field.description: One-based row position in this source snapshot; unique within this record set, not an astronomical catalog identifier or a persistent cross-release key. Absent properties and JSON null are represented as null; missing values are not imputed.

field.name: geometry_wkt
field.description: Original geometry encoded as WKT without reprojection, rounding or simplification. J2000 celestial angles in degrees: x is right ascension converted from hours at 15 degrees/hour and wrapped to [-180,180]; y is declination. These are not terrestrial WGS84 positions. WKT itself does not carry this reference frame. Absent properties and JSON null are represented as null; missing values are not imputed.
